chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Pilat in Zeisu a sap khit ciangin a satsak hi.
Galkapte in ling tawh lukhu ganin ama lu tangah a khusak uh a, puanza san a silhsak khit uh ciangin,
“Judahte’ Kumpipa aw, nang na ci dam ta hen!” ci-in khut tawh a beeng uh hi.
Pilat va paikhia kik a, “Hih mi tungah bangmah mawhna ka muh loh na theih nadingun note kiangah kong lakhia hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Zeisu in ling lukhu khu-in, puanza san silhin a paikhia hi. Pilat in, “En un, hih pa,” a ci hi.

Siampi liante leh upate in Zeisu a muh uh ciangin, “Singlamteh tungah that in! “Singlamteh tungah that in!” ci-in a kiko kik uh hi. Pilat in, “Nomau in amah la un la, singlamteh tungah that un. Ama tungah mawhna ka mu kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite in, “Kote in thukhamna ka nei uh hi. Tua thu tawh kituakin hih pa si dingin kilawm hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in, ‘Pasian’ Tapa ka hi hi,’ a ci hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua thu Pilat in a zak ciangin lau semsem a;
mang inn sungah lut kikin, “Nang koi pan hong piang na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, Zeisu in kamkhat beek a dawng kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Pilat in, “Kei kiangah thu hong gen nuam lo na hi hiam? Keimah in nang kong khah nading thu ahi zongin, singlamteh tungah thah nading thu ahi zongin ka neih thei lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Tung lam pan thu na ngah kei leh, kei tungah bangmah na hih thei kei ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin nangma khut sungah kei a hong piapa in khialhna golzaw a nei hi,” ci-in a thuk hi.

Tua a kipanin Pilat in Zeisu a khah nading a zong zaw hi. Ahih hangin Judah mite in, “Hih pa na khah leh, Kaisar kumpipa’ lawm na hi kei hi; Kaisar kumpipa’ gal ahi kumpipa-a kibawl tawm mi na hi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua thu a zak ciangin Pilat in Zeisu paikhiatpih a, Hebru kamin ‘Gabbatha’ kici ‘Suangphah’ a cihna munah thukhenna tokhom tungah a tu hi.
Tua lai takin, Paisan pawi kigin ni sun lai tak nai sawm leh nai nih ahi hi. Pilat in, Judah mite kiangah, “En un, note’ Kumpipa,” ci-a a gen ciangin

amaute in, “Tua pa that in, tua pa that in, singlamteh tungah that in!” ci-in a kiko uh hi. Pilat in, “Note’ Kumpipa singlamteh tungah that ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Kaisar kumpipa longal adang kumpipa ka nei kei uh hi,” ci-in siampi liante in a dawng kik uh hi.
Tua ciangin, Pilat in Zeisu singlamteh tungah thah dingin amaute’ khut sungah a pia hi.
Tua lai takin amaute in Zeisu la-in a paipih uh hi. Zeisu in ama singlamteh pua a, Hebru kamin ‘Golgotha’ kici ‘Lutangguh Mun’ kicihna ah pai dingin a paikhia hi.
Tua san takah amaute in Zeisu singlamteh tungah a khai uh hi. Amah tawh a lang tuakah mi nih zong a khai uh hi. Zeisu a lai zangah a om hi.
Pilat in laigelh a, singlamteh tungah a suang hi. Tua lai in, “JUDAHTE’ KUMPIPA, NAZARETH KHUAMI ZEISU AHI HI,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Hih lai Judah mi tampite in a sim uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Zeisu singlamteh tungah a kithahna mun in khuapi tawh kinai a; Hebru kam, Latin kam leh Grik kam tawh a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Judah siampi liante in Pilat kiangah va pai uh a, ‘Judahte’ Kumpipa, ci-in gelh kei in; ‘Kei in Judahte’ Kumpipa ka hi hi, a ci hi,’ ci-in laigelh in,” a cih uh ciangin
Pilat in, “Ka gelhsa in ka gelhsa hi,” a ci hi.

Galkapte in Zeisu singlamteh tungah a khai khit uh ciangin, a puante la a, seh li suahin seh khat ciatin a hawm uh a; puanak zong a la uh hi. Hih puanak kikhui loin a lu pan a taw dongin a kiphan ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin, “Hih puan balkeek kei ni. Kua in ngah ding hiam lai-ai i saan ding hi,” ci-in, Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhna thu a tun’ nadingin galkapte a kikum uh hi. Tua thu in: “Amaute khat leh khat in ka puan a hawm uh hi; Ka puan tungah lai-ai a saan uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi. Galkapte in tua thu a bawl uh hi.
Zeisu’ singlamteh kiangah a nu leh a nu’ sanggamnu, Klopas’ zi Mari leh Magdala khua Mari-te a ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, Zeisu in a nu leh a it nungzuipa a kianga ding a muh ciangin, “Numei aw, nang in na tapa en in!” a ci hi.
A nungzuipa kiangah, “Nang na nu en in!” a ci hi. Tua akipanin tua nungzuipa in, Zeisu’ nu ama innah a khoi hi.
Tua nung ciangin Zeisu in thu khempeuh kizo khin zo cih a theih ciangin, Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin a tun’ nadingin, “Tui ka duh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua munah tuikha tawh kidim beel khat om a, amaute in tuipaan khat tuikha sungah a diah khit uh ciangin, pumpeeng dawnah bulhin ama kamah a bak uh hi.
Tua hi a, Zeisu in tui a ngah khit ciangin, “A zo zo hi,” ci-a a lu su-in a si hi.

Tua ni in kigin ni ahih ciangin, Nipi ni-in a luang singlamteh tungah a om loh nadingin, Judah mite in Pilat kiangah a khe kuaitanin a luang a paihkhiat nading thu a va ngen uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua Nipi ni in ni lian mahmah ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin galkapte hong pai uh a, Zeisu tawh singlamteh tungah kithat mi khat’ khe a kuaih tan khit uh ciangin, adang khatpa’ khe a kuaitan uh hi.
Zeisu kiang a tun’ uh ciangin amah si zo ta cih a muh uh ciangin, a khe a kuaitan kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin galkap khat in a pang teipi tawh sun a, si leh tui thakhatin a luangkhia hi.
Tua thu a mu mi in teci a pang hi. Ama teci pan’na thu aman hi. Note in na up theih nadingun ama genna thu aman hi ci-in a thei hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, “A guh khat beek a kikuaitan kei ding hi,” ci-a Lai Siangtho sungah a gen bangin a tun’ nadingin hih teng a kibawl hi.
Adang Lai Siangtho sungah “Tua mite in amaute sutpa a en ding uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.

Tua nung ciangin, Arimathea khua Josef in Judah mite a kihtak manin a kilang loin Zeisu’ thu a zui mi hi a; Zeisu’ luang a paipih nadingin Pilat kiangah a ngen hi. Pilat in thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua pa hong pai a, Zeisu’ luang a paipih hi.
Nidanga zan lai taka Zeisu kiangah a pai Nikodemas in pound zakhat a khai mirrah leh aloes kihel paknamtui a paipih hi.
Tua lai takin amaute in Zeisu’ luang la uh a, Judah mite’ kivui ngeina bangin paknamtui tawh dial sungah a tun uh hi.
Singlamteh tungah thahna mun tawh kinai-ah huan khat om a, tua huan sungah kuama kivui ngei lohna han thak khat a om hi.
Judah mite kigin kholh ni nai ahih ciangin, tua hanah Zeisu a vui uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua han a nai hi.
